name: Hanare Hitoshi
source:
Hailing from a prominent naval family, Hitoshi is an expert sailor. Even at his young age, he is often tasked with commanding one of the patrol ships that ensure the defense of his home islands. He is also a skilled archer with impeccable aim, trained to take out targets on the decks of enemy ships with ease.

Boisterous and rough around the edges, Hitoshi loves to tell stories and crack jokes, and is rarely serious. He hates the responsibility that comes with his status, and especially hates his older brother Hirotaro, who abandoned the family and left Hitoshi with all the duties of the eldest son.

[From [url=http://hub.leadingscientistsgames.com/about/characters/hanare-hitoshi/]official site[/url]]
